title: wave-settings-dialog: the overall-wave gear moves from the track graphics area into the group's title bar (GT11.10 fold header); it opens a NEW two-pane dialog — narrow tab list left («Оба канала» / «Левый» / «Правый»), wide settings pane centre — settings apply per the active tab

decisions.text: ONE gear per group, in the title bar (owner req 1). Today SF27 puts a per-track gear inside EACH overall-wave track's graphics area (WaveformView.vue:35-45), so stereo shows two gears each opening its channel's dialog (TracksPanel.vue:402). Replaced by a single settings button at the right edge of the GT11.10 fold header «Общая волна» (TracksPanel.vue:348-380) — the title's flex:1 pushes it right; @click.stop so the header's fold/Ctrl-click behaviour is untouched. Opens the dialog on the «Оба канала» tab; per-channel access is via the tabs (req 5).

Dialog shape mirrors the GT10.29 precedent (AudioPage.vue:49-86): q-card -> row no-wrap -> narrow q-list (~160px, clickable items + active-class) + q-separator vertical + wide content pane; own CSS classes tracks-panel__wf-settings-*. Stays INLINE in TracksPanel like every other TracksPanel dialog (SF26 minimap, gtrack settings, the old SF27 one): the per-channel state and its localStorage persistence live there, and extracting a component for three controls would only add props/emits plumbing.

REVISED 2026-07-15 (owner req 6: «На форме "Оба канала" нужен тоггл - Применить к обоим каналам. Если он включен, то пункты слева "Левый" и "Правый" становятся недоступны»). State: waveformSettingsOpen: boolean + waveformSettingsTab: 'both' | 0 | 1 (replaces the channel|null open-flag trick at TracksPanel.vue:1850-1860) + waveformLinkChannels: boolean, persisted (WS-D7), default ON. The toggle lives ON the «Оба канала» form, above the settings. Semantics: (a) ON (default) -> the «Оба канала» controls are live and edit THAT group (WS-D9); the «Левый»/«Правый» items are :disable (req 6 verbatim). (b) OFF -> «Левый»/«Правый» are enabled and edit their own channel; the «Оба канала» CONTROLS are disabled (only the toggle stays live) — while unlinked that group drives nothing, so editing it would be an invisible edit. (c) REVISED AGAIN 2026-07-15 (owner req 11: «При переключении тоггла в ON сразу нужно применять текущие настройки к обоим каналам») + (req 12, WS-D9): the toggle SELECTS THE RENDER SOURCE rather than copying values — linked, every channel draws the «Оба канала» group; unlinked, its own. So the flip applies instantly (req 11) with no copy step, and flipping back RESTORES each channel's own settings because they were never touched (req 12). This supersedes the previous rule ('a flip never changes values; levelling happens on the first edit'), and it retires R1's 'no undo' worry: the operation is now fully reversible. (d) get on «Оба канала» reads ITS OWN group, not channel 0 (req 12); the per-channel tabs read the RAW arrays, never wfScale/wfColor/wfOpacity — those answer 'what does this track DRAW', which while linked is the both group, and using them would make the three groups look coupled on screen. The toggle's default ON was CONFIRMED by the owner 2026-07-15 («Согласен дефолт тоггла ON») — see R1 for the one consequence that survives.

REVISED 2026-07-15 (owner req 7: «Моно-файл - один пукт "Моно"»). Mono (isSpectrogramStereo === false, one physical channel): the left list collapses to a SINGLE item labelled «Моно» — the internal tab id stays 'both' (it means the single/all-channels scope; only the label changes), «Левый»/«Правый» are hidden, and the WS-D3 toggle is HIDDEN too ('apply to both channels' is meaningless with one channel). The form edits channel 0.

Overlay mode and gtrack lanes DO NOT move. In overlay the overall-wave stack (and thus its title bar) is not rendered at all — the waveform is drawn over the spectrogram, and SpectrogramView's own gear (visible when waveformOverlay, SpectrogramView.vue:86-92) opens the waveform settings for its channel (TracksPanel.vue:494). That gear stays in place and now opens the NEW dialog preselected on its channel's tab. REVISED 2026-07-15 (req 6): when waveformLinkChannels is ON the per-channel tab is LOCKED, so every per-channel entry point must fall back to «Оба канала» rather than land on a disabled tab — one rule: openWaveformSettings(ch) -> tab = link ? 'both' : ch (applies to the spectrogram overlay gear and, until WS1.2 removes them, the per-track gears too). Gtrack lane gears (per-lane GTrackSpectrumSettings via gtrackSettingsId, TracksPanel.vue:298/254) are untouched.

WaveformView gains prop showSettingsGear with withDefaults default TRUE — NOT a bare type-only boolean (an absent boolean prop casts to false, the known Vue pitfall): lanes pass nothing and keep their gear (it opens per-lane settings), the overall stack passes :show-settings-gear="false". The open-settings emit stays. Mirrors the GT10.3 precedent (SpectrogramView.showSettingsGear:213-214), same prop name, inverted default.

NEW 2026-07-15 (owner req 12: «Настройки на вкладке "Оба канала" не должны изменять настроек на вкладках левого и правого каналов. Это три независимых сущности»). «Оба канала» becomes a THIRD setting group of its own (waveformBothScale/Color/Opacity) instead of a bulk write across L and R: editing any one of the three touches neither of the others. What a TRACK draws is then a selection, not a copy: linked -> the both group, unlinked -> its own channel's (wfScale/wfColor/wfOpacity encode the rule, so the spectrogram's overlay props and the header's colour stripe follow it for free). Two consequences worth keeping: (1) req 11's 'apply immediately' falls out for free — the source changes, nothing is copied — and unlinking restores each channel's settings intact, which retires R1's old 'first edit collapses L/R with no undo'; (2) MONO ignores the toggle entirely — with one channel there is nothing to unify, so its «Моно» tab IS channel 0's group (WS-D4), otherwise one graph would answer to two different groups. Migration: the both group is seeded from channel 0, which is exactly what the «Оба канала» tab displayed in WS1.1; persistence gains `both: {scale,color,opacity}` (WS-D7).

NEW 2026-07-15 (owner req 10: «Диалог колорпикера должен иметь Close иконку в заголовке»). The colour control moves off the native <input type="color">: that element opens the BROWSER's own picker, which is chrome — we cannot put a Close icon on it, so the request is unsatisfiable while it stays. Replaced by the app's own picker: a colour swatch + q-color inside a q-popup-proxy with an X button — precisely the pattern the OWNER themself specified for the lane colours in GT10.20 (TracksPanel's gtrack settings dialog carries the comment «open to the RIGHT of the circle, with a close (X)», owner 2026-07-12), reusing its existing tracks-panel__color-swatch / tracks-panel__color-popup classes. So this also unifies colour picking across the two settings surfaces instead of adding a third style. QPopupProxy has NO `disable` prop (checked in Quasar's source), so the disabled state removes the popup with v-if and marks the swatch with Quasar's `disabled` class + tabindex=-1. The now-userless .audio-page__wf-color rule is deleted from TracksPanel (its twin in AudioPage belongs to the WS2.1 dead duplicate).

The settings SET is unchanged: colour / amplitude scale lin-dB / overlay opacity (the latter, as today, visible only when viewMode === 'overlay'). Persistence keeps the same localStorage key 'mindwave-tracks-waveform' (TracksPanel.vue:1794,1820-1849,2215-2226) and gains TWO fields: link: boolean (WS-D3) and, after the owner's req 12, both: {scale,color,opacity} (WS-D9 — the third group must survive a reload exactly like the other two). Both are backward compatible: absent -> default / seeded from channel 0. No value migration for the per-channel groups.

i18n (ru+en): new key audio.waveformSettingsTitle («Настройки отображения волны» / "Waveform display settings") for the dialog title and the new header button's tooltip/aria; tab keys audio.waveformChannelsBoth/Left/Right («Оба канала» / «Левый» / «Правый», en "Both channels" / "Left" / "Right"); audio.waveformChannelMono («Моно» / "Mono", req 7); audio.waveformApplyBoth («Применить к обоим каналам» / "Apply to both channels", req 6). The owner wrote «Обе канала» and CONFIRMED «Оба канала» 2026-07-15 (req 8) -> R6 closed. Existing audio.waveformStyle stays — the lane gears in WaveformView still use it.

steps.title: Новый двухпанельный диалог настроек волны (вкладки «Оба канала»/«Левый»/«Правый» + тоггл «Применить к обоим каналам») на месте SF27-диалога + i18n; открывается пока из старых гиров (гир канала → вкладка канала, при link=ON → «Оба канала»)
steps.verify: bun run typecheck + bun run build (MindWaveCore/ui); bun test ui server (GnauralCore) зелёные; manual (стерео): тоггл ON — «Левый»/«Правый» недоступны (req 6), правка на «Оба канала» меняет ОБА канала; тоггл OFF — Л/П доступны и правят только свой канал, контролы формы «Оба канала» выключены; флип тоггла сам по себе значений не меняет; гир канала при ON открывает «Оба канала», при OFF — свою вкладку (WS-D5); overlay — слайдер прозрачности виден только там; mono — один пункт «Моно», тоггла нет; закрыть/открыть — значения И состояние тоггла персистятся (localStorage +link, WS-D7)
evidence: Commit 0aaf88a (GnauralCore). Owner approved the WS-D3 default (toggle ON) 2026-07-15 -> implemented as specified; the whole scope model landed in one step because the tab list, the toggle and the wfDlg* accessors are one mechanism (a half-migrated dialog would have been a worse checkpoint than none).

A REAL BUG caught by reading Quasar's source instead of trusting :disable — and it would have broken req 6 outright. QItem.js does NOT set inheritAttrs:false, so a fallthrough @click lands on the root element and Vue runs it ALONGSIDE QItem's own handler; QItem's internal onClick no-ops when disabled (QItem.js:98-99 guards on isClickable), but mine would still have fired. Quasar's `.disabled` rule (css/core/visibility.sass:30-36) only sets outline/cursor/opacity — NOT pointer-events — so the click does reach the element. Net effect without a guard: a LOCKED «Левый»/«Правый» tab still opens on click, i.e. exactly what req 6 forbids, while looking disabled. Fixed with our own guard (selectWaveformSettingsTab returns early). Lesson for this codebase: a Quasar `:disable` dims and drops the component's OWN handling; it does not neutralise a listener you attached.

Mono is not just a label change (WS-D4): 'both' there writes ONLY channel 0. Writing ch 1 as well would have silently overwritten the stored R preference (the arrays are always length 2 and persist), so editing colour on a MONO file would have changed R for the next STEREO file opened — a cross-file data effect with no UI to reveal it. wfDlgTargets() encodes 'every channel that EXISTS', not 'both slots'.

R4 guard implemented as a watch on [isSpectrogramStereo, waveformLinkChannels]: a scope of 0/1 is coerced back to 'both' if the file turns mono under an open dialog, or if the tab it points at gets locked. Keeps the invariant 'a locked/nonexistent tab is never the active one' true by construction rather than by UI convention.
Verify run: vue-tsc --noEmit 0 errors; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui server 252 pass / 0 fail (850 expect()).

Checked what the BUILD cannot catch (a missing i18n key renders as the key string at runtime, silently): a script resolved every t('audio.*') key used by the dialog against BOTH locales — all 6 new keys present in ru+en, and the whole-file sweep found 0 broken keys across 84. Bundle audit: all 5 tracks-panel__wf-settings* rules present in assets/TracksPanel-Cq8da1pU.css, «Применить к обоим каналам» present in the emitted JS.

NOT verified by me: the visual/interaction pass — no browser driver exists anywhere in the workspace (checked), and installing Playwright + Chromium into the owner's actively-running dev environment for one dialog was not proportionate. That check is WS1.3, which is an owner PAUSE by design. What IS confirmed live: the owner's dev server (Mode=dev, quasar dev on 9000 per server/app.cfg) serves the updated module — 9 new-code markers incl. selectWaveformSettingsTab/waveformLinkChannels — so the running app has the change via HMR.

steps.title: Перенос шестерёнки в тайтл-бар «Общая волна»: кнопка в fold-хедере (открывает «Оба канала») + prop showSettingsGear в WaveformView (false в overall-стеке)
steps.verify: typecheck + build; bun test ui server; manual: в области графики дорожек общей волны шестерёнок НЕТ, в тайтл-баре ЕСТЬ (открывает вкладку «Оба канала»); гиры лейнов gtrack на месте и открывают per-lane настройки; overlay-гир спектрограммы открывает новый диалог (при link=ON — на «Оба канала», WS-D5); fold/eye/Ctrl-click хедера не сломаны
evidence: Commit 58f551f (GnauralCore). The header needed NO CSS surgery, as surveyed: the title's flex:1 (tracks-panel__gtrack-header-title) pushes a trailing button to the right edge; the new class only joins the existing `flex: 0 0 auto` rule beside the fold/eye buttons, which are already size=xs in the same 22px bar (R3 closed — nothing clipped, and the tooltip teleports so the header's overflow:hidden cannot cut it).

The gear could not be DELETED from WaveformView (the constraint the plan found before writing code): the gtrack solo sub-lanes reuse the component and their gear opens per-lane settings. Hence WS-D6's prop with withDefaults default true — a bare type-only boolean would cast the absent prop to false and silently strip the lanes' gear (the known Vue pitfall).

Wiring audited by grep rather than assumed, since a stale listener typechecks fine: the overall waveform-view now carries :show-settings-gear=false and its @open-settings listener is GONE (it had become unreachable — the gear was the only emitter). Remaining open-settings listeners are exactly the intended four: 3 gtrack lane ones (GTrackView + solo wave + solo spectrum -> gtrackSettingsId) and the overall SPECTROGRAM's openWaveformSettings(channel), which is the overlay entry point (WS-D5).

@click without .stop matches the neighbouring fold/eye buttons: the header div itself has no click handler — PW5.8's Ctrl-click hide lives on the per-track EYE (onOverallChannelHide via @hide), not on the bar — so there is nothing to stop.
Verify run: vue-tsc --noEmit 0 errors; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui server 252 pass / 0 fail. Bundle: the tracks-panel__gtrack-header-gear rule is present in the emitted CSS.

Note for the reviewer: WaveformView.vue moved under me mid-step — commit 1016af4 (TT2.10, the readout tooltip) landed during this session. Diff re-read before staging: it touches the readout, not the gear; my working diff contains only my lines.

steps.title: Доработки по проверке WS1.3 (owner feedback, req 9-12): отступ шестерёнки; свой колорпикер с X; мгновенное применение при link=ON + три независимые сущности
steps.verify: typecheck + build; bun test ui server; правило margin-right гира и разметка пикера — в бандле; manual: (req 9) гир отстоит от правого края как на графике; (req 10) цвет открывает СВОЙ пикер с X в заголовке; (req 11) флип тоггла в ON перекрашивает оба канала сразу; (req 12) выключение тоггла ВОЗВРАЩАЕТ L/R их собственные настройки, а правка «Оба канала» их не трогает
evidence: Owner review at the WS1.3 PAUSE: «В целом, всё хорошо» + 4 remarks -> reqs 9-12. Reqs 11+12 are ONE change, not two: they only look like separate asks. Copying the both-values into L/R on link (a literal reading of req 11) would 'изменять настройки на вкладках левого и правого каналов' — exactly what req 12 forbids. The only model satisfying both is that the toggle SELECTS the render source (WS-D9): linked -> every channel draws the both group; unlinked -> its own. Then 'apply immediately' needs no code at all (the source changed, reactivity does the rest) and the L/R groups are untouched by construction.

That model also RETIRED a risk instead of managing it: R1 used to read 'the first edit collapses L/R into one colour and there is no undo'. With three independent groups nothing is overwritten — turning the toggle off restores each channel's own colour. What survives is only a default-ON consequence, now recorded in R1 and flagged to the owner: on load both channels draw ONE colour (the both group, seeded from channel 0's cyan), so the familiar L-cyan/R-amber contrast is not visible until the toggle is switched off.

req 10 was unsatisfiable as literally posed, and that is the finding: <input type="color"> opens the BROWSER's picker — chrome we cannot add a Close icon to. So the control had to go. It was replaced with the owner's OWN pattern rather than an invented one: GT10.20 (owner 2026-07-12) already specifies a swatch + q-color in a popup «with a close (X)» for the lane colours, in this same file — same classes reused, so colour picking is now one pattern across both settings surfaces. QPopupProxy has no `disable` prop (checked in Quasar's source, not assumed), hence v-if + the `disabled` class + tabindex=-1 for the inert state.

req 9 measured, not eyeballed: the graph gear sat in .waveform-view__actions at right: 4px, and the header bar has no padding, so the button was flush at 0. Same button, margin-right: 4px -> identical gap. Verified in the emitted CSS: 'tracks-panel__gtrack-header-gear[data-v-122a0e5c]{margin-right:4px}'.

Dead code removed with its last user: .audio-page__wf-color styled only the deleted native input. Confirmed via the bundle that it is gone from TracksPanel's CSS chunk while the copy in AudioPage-*.css remains — that twin belongs to the §2.6 dead duplicate (WS2.1), not to this step.

Verify run: vue-tsc --noEmit 0 errors; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui server 252 pass / 0 fail. Bundle audit: the header-gear margin rule and the tracks-panel__color-popup markup are both present. Visual/interaction pass remains the owner's (WS1.3) — still no browser driver in the workspace. Commit 07f86df (GnauralCore).

steps.title: Чистка осиротевшего острова в AudioPage после выделения TracksPanel (GT2.4): ~301 недостижимая строка + инертный state, который их «держит» (side-find §2.6) — по решению владельца
steps.verify: typecheck + build после КАЖДОГО из двух проходов (сначала недостижимое, потом ставший недостижимым state); manual smoke: вкладка Треки работает (её рисует TracksPanel), prefs не сбрасываются
evidence: SURVEYED 2026-07-15 (owner asked for detail). Cause is recorded in the code itself: AudioPage.vue:364-366 says «the whole new track stack lives in TracksPanel.vue (its own zoom/selection state + storage keys)» (GT2.4/GT-D10) — the tab was moved out at :368 but the old inline implementation was never deleted. AudioPage's template ends at line 427; its script is 1515 lines, of which a scan of all 211 top-level declarations found 64 declarations / ~301 lines unreachable from BOTH the template and the side-effect blocks (onMounted/watch). Largest runs: :1030-1077 (wfScale/wfColor/wfOpacity + the whole wfDlg* dialog state), :1133-1204 (hide/show/reorder + hiddenTrackList + showWaveform/viewModeLabel), :1272-1327 and :1464-1537 (the waveform/spectrogram resize handlers), :1392-1419 (spectrogram zoom).

TWO OF MY OWN EARLIER CLAIMS WERE WRONG — corrected here and in the plan (§2.6, R5), because the owner would have decided on them: (1) 'writes the SAME localStorage key' is FALSE — AudioPage reads/writes 'mindwave-audio-waveform' (:983), TracksPanel uses 'mindwave-tracks-waveform'; the keys never meet. (2) 'a mine that will one day overwrite the user's prefs' is FALSE — the watch at :1205-1220 CANNOT fire: its deps are mutated only by the wfDlg* setters (:1059/1067/1075), which are themselves unreachable, and viewMode/minimapMode are never assigned anywhere. The island is inert. Lesson: I recorded a risk from the SHAPE of the code (a watch writing localStorage) without reading the key or asking who could trigger it.

The real cost is not data, it is misinformation: ~300 lines read as working code and have ALREADY diverged from the live copy — AudioPage still carries the pre-WS1.1 dialog model (waveformSettingsChannel: number|null) and the pre-GT11.7 split resize handlers (onWaveformDividerPointerDown), which TracksPanel replaced with the unified onOverallResize*. A future session editing 'the waveform settings' in AudioPage would change nothing at runtime.
Why nothing catches it: no ESLint anywhere, and <script setup> exposes every top-level binding to the template, so vue-tsc cannot report them as unused. Only an explicit reachability pass finds this.

Scope note for whoever does it: delete the unreachable part FIRST, then the state it holds up (prefs/order/hidden/waveformTracks/spectrogramTracks/heights + the inert watch), typecheck+build between the two passes. The orphaned storage keys ('mindwave-audio-waveform', 'mindwave-audio-track-layout', 'mindwave-audio-waveform-track-heights') are read only by this copy and written by nobody.

log.text:
PHASE 1 CLOSED — owner «Fixed» at WS1.3. Delivered against reqs 1-12 (GnauralCore 0aaf88a, 58f551f, 07f86df). Remaining: WS2.1 only, awaiting the owner's decision.

WS2.1 surveyed on request («Расскажи про WS2.1 подробно. Где это?») — and the survey CORRECTED TWO CLAIMS I HAD PUT IN THIS LEDGER MYSELF. I had recorded that AudioPage's leftover copy 'writes the SAME localStorage key' and was 'a mine that will one day overwrite the user's prefs'. Both are false: the copy uses its own key 'mindwave-audio-waveform' (AudioPage.vue:983) while TracksPanel uses 'mindwave-tracks-waveform', and its watch CANNOT fire at all — the only writers of its deps are the wfDlg* setters, which nothing can reach, and viewMode/minimapMode are never assigned. I had inferred a risk from the SHAPE of the code (a watch → localStorage) without reading the key or asking who could trigger it. The owner was about to decide whether to clean it up based on that. Corrected in §2.6 and R5.

What the survey found instead, and it is bigger than 'a duplicate of the waveform state': GT2.4 moved the whole Треки tab into TracksPanel (the template even says so at AudioPage.vue:364-366) but never deleted the old inline implementation. A reachability scan over all 211 top-level declarations of AudioPage's 1515-line script: 64 declarations / ~301 lines are unreachable from the template AND from every side-effect block; the state they hang off stays technically 'reachable' only through the inert watch. It has already DIVERGED from the live copy (pre-WS1.1 dialog model; pre-GT11.7 split resize handlers that TracksPanel no longer has), so it is not just dead — it misinforms.

Method note for the next session: the first scan was wrong twice and both errors flattered the conclusion. It split template/script on the first '</template>' (slot templates nest -> everything looked script-side), and it did not treat onMounted/watch as roots (-> handlePlayerKeyDown, $q and router looked dead). Check a scanner against a case you KNOW is alive before believing its output — TracksPanel was that control here.

WS1.3 iteration 1: owner «В целом, всё хорошо» + 4 remarks (req 9-12) -> WS1.4 (07f86df). The interesting part is that two of the four collapsed into one change and one was impossible as posed.

req 11 ('flipping the toggle ON must apply the current settings to both channels immediately') and req 12 ('the «Оба канала» tab must not change the L/R tabs' settings — three independent entities') look like separate asks but only ONE model satisfies both: copying both-values into L/R on link — the literal reading of req 11 — is precisely what req 12 forbids. So the toggle stopped writing anything and became a SELECTOR of the render source. 'Apply immediately' then costs no code at all (the source changes; reactivity does the rest), the L/R groups are untouched by construction, and the flip became fully reversible — which retired R1's 'first edit collapses L/R, no undo' rather than mitigating it. Worth remembering: when two requirements seem to conflict, the resolution was a different mechanism, not a compromise between them.

The control had to go, so the question became what replaces it, and the answer was already in the same file: GT10.20, where the owner had specified a swatch + q-color popup «with a close (X)» for the lane colours on 2026-07-12. The one defect found was found by reading Quasar's source, not by running anything — and it would have defeated the owner's requirement while LOOKING right: QItem does not set inheritAttrs:false, so my @click fell through onto the root element and Vue ran it beside QItem's own guarded handler, while Quasar's `.disabled` rule sets no pointer-events. A 'disabled' «Левый» tab would have opened on click. Guard is now ours. Generalisable for this codebase: Quasar's :disable dims the control and drops the component's OWN handling — it does not neutralise a listener you attached to it.
